title: Updates/13.10.12852
name: Winter Update 2022
summary: Implementation of the Wheel of Destiny, Mitigation, quality of life features, Ingol island and Iksupan area, new equipment and quests, a new mount, and a new outfit
changes:
- New main questline: The Cradle of Monsters Quest, which explores the new island of Ingol that lies between Roshamuul and Marapur.
- Extension of the Adventures of Galthen Quest with the addition of the Galthen and the City of Gold mission. Explore the new hunting ground known as Iksupan, the legendary city of gold. Its difficulty lies a bit below the Kilmaresh Catacombs.
- New Imbuements widget which displays the imbuements that each item in your inventory has, in which slot they are, and an indicator that informs how much time is left - for each imbuement on each item. This indicator displays the remaining time exact to the minute. In addition, a colour allows an easier overview:
	- White: you have 3 hours or more left.
	- Yellow: you have between 1 hour and 3 hours left.
	- Red: you have less than 1 hour left.
- New Gather All option on the context menu of the Reward Chest in the Adventurers' Guild which allow players to put as many items as possible in their inventory, limited only by the character's capacity and the room in backpacks.
- Reduction of boss cooldowns: Bosses that currently have a cooldown of 1 day or even longer - such as The Last Lore Keeper, Ferumbras Mortal Shell, Mazoran and Razzagorn - will have their cooldown reduced by 4 hours.
- New hunting area with difficulty lying between Bounac and The Secret Library Quest.
	- The mission Hungry New World of the Krailos Quest is needed to access part of it.
- New items for levels 250 to 300.
- New mount: Mutated Abomination.
- New outfit: Ancient Aucar Outfits.
- Introduction of the Wheel of Destiny
	- Starting with level 51, all promoted characters on Premium accounts will gain 1 promotion point per level which they can spend (e.g. a level 1000 will have 950 points)
	- Wheel of Destiny contains four domains, each containing nine slices for 36 in total. You can fill the slices with points to improve your character
	- Players start in the center of the Wheel of Destiny, with a limited choice of perks to choose from. As soon as they have filled a initial slice completely, they are able to invest points into the adjacent slices. Thus, they can branch out and make their way towards the outer circle where the strongest perks can be unlocked. Each vocation has a unique wheel with its own spells and effects, with some that overlap.
	- Three perk types are available:
		- Dedication Perks, which have small effects that gradually increase existing characteristics, e.g. HP or mana. Every promotion point invested raises the bonus in question a bit until the maximum number of points possible for the slice
		- Conviction Perks, which have medium to large effects that augment existing spells, grant vocation-specific passive abilities or generally useful bonuses like elemental resistance. A Conviction Perk is unlocked once the respective slice has been filled to the max. Most Conviction Perks can be found more than once within the Wheel of Destiny, and when multiple are unlocked, their effects add up.
		- Revelation Perks, which have powerful effects that grant new spells or strong passive effects with considerable impact. There are four Revelation Perks and each of them is assigned to one of the four domains of the wheel. A Revelation Perk has 3 power stages, and they can be unlocked through spending enough promotion points in the respective domain: 250 points for stage 1,500 for stage 2, and 1000 for stage 3
- Shielding rebalance
	- To make shielding skill, shield attributes and combat stances more relevant, an additional way of damage mitigation is implemented. Mitigation reduces all damage of the common damage types (Physical, Earth, Ice, Fire, Energy, Holy and Death) by a percentage. This percentage will be calculated based on several factors:
		- shielding skill
		- choice of equipment (e.g. shield vs two-handed weapon, defense value of equipment)
		- choice of combat stance (offensive, balanced or defensive)
	- Mitigation will benefit players as well as monsters, including bosses, so expect some of them to be harder after the update
	- The Protector spell is adjusted so that its increase of the shielding skill will be reduced. Instead of raising the skill to 220%, it will now raise it to 135%. Due to the addition of Mitigation, the spell's actual impact is expected to be greater after the update.
	- All bows and crossbows will increase mitigation on Paladins.
- Monster damage rebalance: after the update, Medium Monsters will deal ~1% more damage, Hard Monsters ~3% more, and Challenging Monsters ~5% more. This will have no impact on bosses.
- Other changes
	- The minimum size of the Tibia windowed mode increased to 1024x720

title: Updates/13.12.13018
summary: Market fee increase and several bugfixes and changes
changes:

title: Updates/13.20.13560
name: Summer Update 2023
summary: Implementation of Oskayaat, Paradise Lost Quest, Rotten Blood Quest, new best in slot equipment, and more.
changes:
- Implementation of the Paradise Lost Quest, a continuation of the Grimvale Quest storyline that takes place in a new island called Oskayaat.
- The Wheel of Destiny receives preset options to allow players to switch between different configurations more easily, and a new planner tool feature in the website to allow players to preview and plan their wheel.
- Implementation of a visual Loot Highlight on corpses, a new widget for Bosstiary Tracker, and new configurations to help organize items obtained from NPC traders or the Stash.
- Implementation of the Monster Reference Level, to make hunting grounds more difficult for characters under a certain level cap.This was briefly mentioned on teasers, but only officially revealed and given a proper name on 7852
- Implementation of the Rotten Blood Quest, introducing Bakragore as the root of the rotten evil that has defiled the once hallowed halls of the blood god's temple, also known as the Lord of Sanguine Tides.
	- Extra challenging 5-man bosses and gameplay mechanics for high level players, especially those who already conquered Soul War and Gnomprona.
	- New best in slot gear: Sanguine Set. Weapons for all vocations, legs (Knights, Paladins) and boots (Druids, Sorcerers). They have Sanguine Powers, Augments that enhance some of the vocation's finest spells. They can be obtained by defeating bosses in the new Rotten Blood Quest, as well as through Crimson Offerings, a new way of obtaining best in slot gear.
	- Bakragore's Taints, Bakragore's Final Taint, and Bakragore's Burden are new mechanics to increase both the difficulty and the rewards further.
	- Addition of the Blood Vestibule, an underground hub connecting four hunting grounds. In addition to monsters and their main elemental damages, each hunting ground has a core mechanic that will challenge players even further, aiming at a dynamic high risk/high reward hunting experience:
		- Jaded Roots: Earth/Physical/Fire damages. Chance of spawning a decaying totem upon the death of a monster. This totem sets off four consecutive ring spells in expanding ripples, each of them dealing considerable damage, before it vanishes.
		- Putrefactory: Death/Ice/Energy damages. Indestructible rotating totems are scattered in this hunting ground. They unleash large wave spells. If a creature dies near a totem, the damage that is dealt through the totem increases.
		- Gloom Pillars: Holy/Fire/Earth damages. Characters absorb dark energy here. If the dark energy of a character reaches a certain number of charges, a painful chain spell triggers on top of the character dealing Agony Damage. If there are other characters nearby, the chain spell can hit up to 5 targets with increasing agony damage.
		- Darklight Core: Energy/Physical/Ice damages. Creatures can put a Darkfield below characters. It can be compared to a fire field but it deals considerable agony damage instead. A darkfield can only be destroyed through Destroy Field Runes, but will always inflict damage on the initial target.
- New Promotion Scrolls, that grant up to 50 additional points for a character to spend in the Wheel of Destiny.

For example: Party members A, B and C have 3 taints each, D has 1 taint. The party's taint level is 1. They kill a Rotten Blood boss they have not killed yet in that cycle and the individual taint level of A, B and C will remain at 3. The taint level of D will be increased to 2. If A, B and C want to raise their taint level, they need to fight the boss with a party taint level of at least 3.

title: Updates/13.30.14423
name: Winter Update 2023
summary: Implementation of the Gem Atelier and addition of Transcendence effects when upgrading leg equipments. Continuation of the Adventures of Galthen Quest. New items, quests, areas, monsters, outfit, mount, and more.
changes:
- 10 new titles from the 7419 contest.
- New mystic jaguar mount and the possibility to complete the Ancient Aucar Outfits.
- Continuation of Galthen's storyline, going even deeper into Iksupan's mystical past.
	- Galthen and the City of Gold must be completed to be able to start the new quest.
	- New creatures and mysteries on new Iksupan's areas and hunting grounds, targeted at mid-level players, the difficulty is comparable to Haunted Nexus.
- Exaltation Forge enhancement, introducing three new features:
	- Convergence Fusion, exclusive for classification 4. An option to fuse different items of the same body slot for an additional cost in gold. This option offers a guaranteed result, but without triggering bonus effects.
	- Convergence Transfer, exclusive for classification 4. An option that eliminates the tier loss during the transfer, but comes with significantly higher gold costs.
	- Transcendence, the inclusion of tier items for the legs slot. Characters wearing a tiered leg piece have the chance to transcend into their vocation’s Avatar Stage 3 for 7 seconds, whenever using a weapon, offensive rune or offensive spell.
- A fresh adventure called 20 Years a Cook Quest.
	- Journey to mystical destinations within the realm of Tibia, encounter iconic individuals, and confront illustrious adversaries.
	- As reward, they will receive the Draccoon Herald Outfits.
	- The level of difficulty falls somewhere in between that of the Dream Labyrinth and the Cobra Bastion.
- Old world bosses rework: Ferumbras, Orshabaal, Morgaroth and Ghazbaran will take less damage from players’ attacks upon spawning. Their resilience decreases each second after that, slowly returning to regular values.
- Added the Managed Container Extension, which provides additional organisation possibility for items obtained from NPC traders or the Stash, with a replica of categories found in the current Managed Loot Containers.
- Hireling Cook can now sell specific dishes of a player's choice for 90,000 gold.
- Implementation the Gem Atelier, a new element for the Wheel of Destiny, expanding the possibilities of character customization, introducing the concept of Gems, Mods, and Vessels.
	- Gems: exist in three different sizes - lesser, regular and greater - for each vocation.
		- Gems drop from some archfoe bosses, as well as from Fiendish and Influenced Creatures, and can be traded, as long as they are not revealed.
		- Revealed gems have a domain affinity as well as a number of mods depending on the quality.
		- Lesser Gems will have one random Basic Mod, Regular Gems will have two random Basic Mods, and Greater Gems will have two random Basic Mods and one Supreme Mod.
	- Mods: There will be 49 distinct basic Mods (18 vocation-specific, 31 general), and 23 distinct Supreme Mods (19 vocation-specific, 4 general).
		- A new Mod called Revelation Mastery will be introduced. This Mod grants 150 Promotion Points of progress for the corresponding Revelation Perk.
	- Vessels: each domain in the Wheel of Destiny has sockets to put revealed gems into, called vessels.
		- Four new Conviction Perks, called Vessel Resonance, are introduced.
		- Characters with Vessel Resonance matching the gem size of the gem put into the domain's vessel are granted a bonus of +1 to both damage and healing, with the bonus increasing to +2 in case of Greater Gems.
		- To compensate the reduction in Conviction Perks, every character reaching level 51 in the future, or those already at level 51 or higher at release, will be granted eight gems with elemental resistance Mods.

title: Updates/15.10.46b862
name: Summer Update 2025
summary: New Bloody Tusks Quest and Between the Lines Quest, with new equipment, new hunting areas, and new monsters. Imbuing system improvements. Visual improvements for Special Conditions. Addition of the Weapon Proficiency system.
changes:
- New Bloody Tusks Quest for Premium Accounts and a minimum level requirement of 250, containing a new storyline about a creepy orcish and vampiric reunion.
	- Implementation of new hunting grounds with new enemies, having expected difficulty somewhere between Bulltaur Lair/Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground and Ingol.
	- New challenges containing complex mechanics.
	- New equipment can be obtained, but they are not best in slot.
- New Between the Lines Quest for Premium Accounts and characters with the Familiar spell, introducing a new storyline about mysterious books that develop a life of their own.
	- Implementation of new hunting grounds with new enemies, having expected difficulty level comparable to Lion Sanctum and Asura Palace.
	- New outfit and items as rewards
- Changes to the Imbuing System:
	- The success rate boost is being eliminated. All imbuements will have a 100% success rate going forward, with the gold cost being adjusted to 7,500gp (Basic), 60,000gp (Intricate), and 250,000gp (Powerful).
	- The Imbuing Shrine menu has been updated to reflect the changes and to enhance overall usability. It now displays only the imbuement slots that are actually available for each item.
	- Introduction to Tradeable Imbuement Scrolls
		- A new item called Blank Imbuement Scroll has been introduced. It can be obtained as loot, and also purchased from NPC Albinius for 25,000 gold.
		- At any imbuing shrine, a Powerful Imbuement can be inscribed onto the blank scroll. This consumes the blank imbuement scroll and produces a powerful imbuement scroll.
		- To perform this inscription, the player must have permission to create powerful imbuements and a Premium Account.
		- There are a total of 24 unique powerful imbuement scrolls, one for each imbuement type.
		- Powerful imbuement scrolls and blank imbuement scrolls are stackable and tradeable in the Market. Powerful imbuement scrolls can also be purchased and used by Free Account players.
		- Furthermore, an Etcher removes all imbuements from an item. It costs 30,000 gold and is also sold by NPC Albinius.
- Addition to HUD capability to showcase Special Conditions beside character's health arcs.
- Addition of a new Weapon Proficiency system that allows players to unlock new mods as their characters become proficient with each weapon they use. This comes with several changes:
	- Nearly every weapon has its own Weapon Proficiency with 1 to 7 levels, each level having 1 to 3 unlockable perks.
	- Players gain character bound Proficiency Progress with a weapon by killing monsters while the weapon is equipped.
	- All characters now have a default Critical Hit chance of 5%, as well as 10% critical Extra Damage, and all weapons no longer provide any critical hit chance by default.
	- Strike Imbuements have been rebalanced to align with the new base values. Example: Powerful Strike changed from "+10% critical hit chance, +50% critical extra damage" --> "+5% critical hit chance, +40% critical extra damage".
	- Certain weapons now have reduced attributes, with the goal that they are compensated and often exceeded quickly by reaching higher levels of Weapon Proficiency.
	- All sources of critical hit chance are now added together and displayed in the Offence Stats section of the Cyclopedia.

title: Updates/15.01.4b0877

As part of general balancing and to enhance the appeal of other options and spells for the Monk, some adjustments were made:
- Virtue of Justice: Fist Fighting bonus was reduced from 10/20% to 8/16%.
- Chained Penance: jump bonus was reduced from +3% to -9%. The spell's position within the Wheel of Destiny was also adjusted to make the additional target available earlier.
- Virtue Healing depends now much more on Magic Level than character level and, as a result, the overall self healing power has been reduced.

Furthermore, the following changes were made:
- Adjusted general chain spell behavior:
	- if your current target is out of range, these spells will now try to start their chain on a valid target within range
	- if there is no valid target in range, the spell will not be cast (this affects all player chain spells)
- Spiritual Outburst: Mana is now consumed only if the spell is successfully cast
- Harmony points are now generally no longer consumed before the respective spell is actually cast

title: Updates/15.12.c7d92c
name: Newhaven Update
summary: Introduction of the new tutorial area called Newhaven and removal of Dawnport, changes to NPC dialogues, changes to Achievements.
changes:
- A new linear tutorial replaces Dawnport with Newhaven. Dawnport will be removed from the game.
- A new NPC dialogue interface makes conversations more convenient and immersive. Vendors, bankers, and transport NPCs display small optional icons above their heads indicating their function.
- A new info banner displays milestones like level-ups and hints for players up to level 20.
- An optional melee weapon animation for auto-attacks appears in the game window.
- Existing characters can no longer return to Rookgaard after the update. New characters can travel to Rookgaard via Newhaven.
- Adjustments to existing systems:
	- The Mana costs of all wands and rods requiring level 20 or lower have been drastically reduced.
	- The Arrow Call spell now creates 30 arrows instead of 3 per cast, costs 30 mana instead of 10, and is automatically granted to Paladins after choosing their Vocation.
	- The range difficulty system has been streamlined. As a result, lower-level Paladins will now hit their targets more reliably from a distance. This change does not affect characters with higher distance levels.
	- Regeneration rates have been adjusted:
		- all vocations now regenerate at the same intervals (every 4 seconds for HP and 6 seconds for Mana, the amount regenerated depends on the vocation
		- eating Food shorts the interval to 3 seconds for HP and 5 seconds for mana
	- Achievements have been adjusted to remain obtainable.
	- Berserk, Mastermind, and Bullseye Potions, as well as the Jack to the Future Quest, become available to all vocations (potions without effect).
	- A few quests can now be replayed for their alternative achievement, costing a high gold fee.
	- Reduction of the weight of Gold Coins and empty flasks:
		- coins from 0.1 oz to 0.01 oz per coin
		- empty great potion flask from 1.80 to 1.35 oz
		- empty strong potion flask from 1.60 to 1.00 oz
		- empty potion flask from 1.50 to 0.75 oz
	- A new Monk Spell, Lesser Mystic Repulse, is being introduced and can be learnt from level 6 at Newhaven.
	- Flame Strike and Ice Strike can now be learnt starting at level 8.
	- Apprentice's Strike now requires level 6 and can be learnt both in Newhaven and on mainland.
	- The base capacity for all characters has been increased by 200, raising it to 600. This will only take effect once a character levels up.
	- The Harmony Amulet will no longer have a level requirement.

Additionally to the new tutorial area, a few balancing changes were released:
- Bounac
	- The respawn time of regular lion creatures in the outer regions of the castle is now significantly longer.
	- All regular usurper creatures will switch targets much more frequently, but will mostly prioritize players who have already attacked them
	- On the east coast of the bastion, the number of usurper creatures that vanish into the boss fight when the lever is pulled has been heavily reduced.
	- Usurper raids now last longer and are announced by text messages in the affected areas.
	- Several narrow passages in the maps have been broadened to allow smoother hunting.
	- The monster density on the east coast and in the western part of the bastion has been increased.
	- Usurper Knight: increased Physical Damage sensitivity: 65 → 85
- Hell Hub/Grounds
	- Grimeleech: reduced gold gain by 8%
- Monk vocation adjustments:
	- Weapons with an attack value of 35 or higher have had their attack reduced by 2.
	- Weapons with an attack value below 35 have had their attack reduced by 1, except for those with less than 15 attack, which remain unchanged.
	- Harmony: the base bonus was reduced from 8% to 7%, and the Virtue of Harmony base bonus was reduced from 4% to 3% (8% to 6% in Serene state)

changes:

	- Inclusion of the The Order of the Stag, led by Eldoran the Ambitious, heir to Eldoran, the lost bastard of the Etzel clan.

- Implementation of a new option that allows players to apply an object directly to whatever lies beneath their mouse cursor, reducing the number of required clicks from two to one.

title: Updates/15.22.c93366
name: Auto-learn Spells Update
changes:
The update changed the game so that spells are unlocked automatically upon leveling up and no longer require any cost:
- Spells that previously had to be learnt from spell trainers are now unlocked automatically when levelling up, free of charge.
- Spell trainers can no longer teach spells; related NPCs and map guides have been adjusted accordingly. NPCs remain available for interaction, but no longer teach spells.
- Spells are unlocked at the same level as before and remain available in the Spellbook and the Magical Archive.
- Newly unlocked spells are automatically added to the Action Bars if space is available. This behaviour can be disabled in the options.
- For existing characters, all spells up to the current character level are unlocked automatically without being added to the Action Bar.
- Each newly unlocked spell is announced via a banner message.
- These changes apply to all characters, regardless of Free or Premium status.
- Not affected are starting spells, spells from the Wheel of Destiny, and spells learned via quests, shrines, or specific NPC interactions.

Additionally, changes were made to:
- Bone Overlord boss fight
	- Players can no longer be feared over Wraithfire fields.
	- Changed the super drunken spell to regular Drunk.
	- Decreased the duration of root and fear.
	- Slightly reduced the damage from An Eye.
- The Order of the Stag Quest areas

	- Reduced the monster density at Bastion and Adaean Mines.

	- Skeleton Elite Warrior: increased XP 4,800 → 5,370.
- General changes:

title: Updates/15.24.95dcf3
name: Targuna Update
summary: Implementation of Targuna, a new player island. Addition of new boss, new monsters, new items, a new mount, and the Targuna Quest.
changes:
The patch released a new player island, Targuna, which becomes the new destination after Newhaven. Additionally:
- New guidance from level 8 to level 20
- New Reliable Ram mount
- Three hunting grounds with different access types and difficulty levels
- Additional pop-ups in Newhaven to explain progression and next steps
- New tutorial-style quests for Your Supply Stash, Daily Reward System, and banking
- New multi offline training statue
- New map markers for key locations
- Reworked travel to Thais; permanent free passage unlockable via a special Sail Pass loot item or a 5,000 gold payment
- Shared Experience is now enabled by default for parties
- In the Cyclopedia, the default loot value source for new client installations has been changed from NPC Buy Value to Market Value

In a separate 8730, balancing changes and other fixes were announced:
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from reaching the world boss Abomination.
- Fixed an issue that caused Falcon Knights and Falcon Paladins to spawn too close together within a small area during the Court Warlock boss fight.
- NPC Tarak now also transports free account characters.
- Fixed an issue where players who chose their vocation on Rookgaard or Dawnport were unable to learn some spells.
- Balancing:
	- Gnomegate Fungus Dungeon (Warzone 1)
		- Stone Devourer: increased gold gain by 14%
		- Armadile: increased gold gain by 14%
		- Reduced the cooldown of the raid from 15 to 10 minutes.
	- Book World
		- Cinder Wyrmling: increased XP by 9%
		- Bramble Wyrmling: increased XP by 9%
		- Shell Drake: increased XP by 12%
		- Hawk Hopper: increased XP by 14%
	- Castle Catacombs
		- Spellreaper Inferniarch: increased gold gain by 8%
		- Hellhunter Inferniarch: increased gold gain by 10%
		- Brinebrute Inferniarch: increased gold gain by 8% and changed loot from platinum to crystal coins.
		- Malvaroth: changed loot from platinum to crystal coins.
	- Unhallowed Crypt
		- Crypt Fiend: decreased XP by 15%
		- Crypt Construct: decreased XP by 4%
		- Creepy Crawler: decreased XP by 3%
	- Forsaken Crypt
		- Cyclursus: decreased XP by 12%
		- Roaming Dread: decreased XP by 14%
		- Crypt Mage: decreased XP by 4%
	- Other
		- Wiggler: Increased gold gain by 100%, a few mechanical changes have been made that slightly weaken the creature.
		- Added creature products from Dwelling of the Forgotten to the Delivery Tasks.
